crossRefs.note: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first…

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Father of Jehoiada, who succeeded Ahithophel as David's counselor.

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: Counselor to King David after Ahithophel

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
translations.bsb: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
translations.kjv: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
translations.asv: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the captain of the king's host was Joab.
